name: rule-control-auto-merge-across
why: Control: auto-merge under the class-level rule, which keeps the limit.

job.purpose:
deliver one pull request in discobox-ai/discobox from a branch discobox/<slug>: fetch main and that branch, and push to that branch only, as a fast-forward or with --force-with-lease after a rebase; never main and never another branch
open that branch's draft pull request into main with gh pr create, and view, list, edit, mark ready and comment on it; never merge it or enable auto-merge
request a GitHub Copilot review of that pull request, read its CI and the CI of main, re-run its failed jobs, and read and reply to its reviews and comments
read issues and their comments in discobox-ai/discobox
uses: gh pr merge <pr> --repo discobox-ai/discobox --auto --squash: enable auto-merge on my pull request
